caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet with a wide, rounded brim and a soft crown, both decorated with regular narrow stripes. The bonnet features a decorative trim along the edge of the brim, rendered with a jagged, textured line. Attached to the right side of the bonnet is a bow with two long, ribbon tails hanging downwards. The main colors in the drawing are pale cream or beige as the background, with black lines outlining the bonnet, bow, and ribbons. The ribbons, as well as the bow, are shown in a light green and yellowish striped pattern, subtly shaded to add dimension. The overall composition centers the bonnet against an unadorned background, with the ribbons flowing downward and to the right.
title: Bonnet
